title: DecompGym: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Designing Decomposition Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.38175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benders decomposition and column generation solve large optimization problems by passing cuts, columns, and dual values between a master problem and subproblems, and are hard to implement correctly. Large language models now automate parts of algorithm design, which points toward agents that build decomposition solvers for new problems. As a first step toward such agents, we study how well current coding agents design and implement these two algorithms, and how they fail. We introduce DecompGym, 81 instances from nine problem families (five Benders, four column generation), in which an agent writes a solver for a prescribed method. Each solver must meet three criteria: execution within a 60-second time limit; numerical feasibility together with a method audit, in which an LLM judge reads the solver's code; and an objective within 1% of the stored optimal objective. We evaluate 12 GPT, Claude, and Gemini models running in coding-agent too

translated_title: DecompGym：面向分解算法设计的大语言模型智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: Benders分解和列生成方法通过在主问题与子问题之间传递割平面、列和对偶值来求解大规模优化问题，但正确实现这些算法十分困难。大语言模型如今已能自动化部分算法设计工作，这预示着未来可以构建为新问题搭建分解求解器的智能体。作为迈向此类智能体的第一步，我们研究了当前编码智能体在设计和实现这两种算法时的表现，以及它们失败的原因。我们提出了DecompGym，这是一个包含来自九个问题家族（五个Benders分解、四个列生成）共81个实例的基准测试，要求智能体为指定的方法编写求解器。每个求解器必须满足三项标准：在60秒时限内完成执行；满足数值可行性并通过方法审计（由大语言模型评判者阅读求解器代码）；目标值与存储的最优目标值偏差在1%以内。我们评估了12个运行于编码智能体工具中的GPT、Claude和Gemini模型
tldr: 该论文提出了DecompGym基准测试，通过81个来自九个问题家族的实例，系统评估大语言模型编码智能体设计和实现Benders分解与列生成等优化分解算法的能力及其失败模式。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces DecompGym, a benchmark with 81 instances from nine problem families that evaluates how well LLM coding agents design and implement decomposition algorithms like Benders decomposition and column generation for large-scale optimization.
